# Gather

> Gather is a free Chrome extension and web library for highlighting text on any website. Select text, click Save (or add a note or category), and Gather keeps the highlight on the page and saves it to a private library organised by date and website, with full-text search across highlights and notes. Tagline: "Keep what matters. Find it later."

- Website: https://gatherme.vercel.app
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mjnohkfaifggignaafjmdkhcncloogho
- Price: free
- Platform: Google Chrome (desktop) and Chromium browsers that install Chrome Web Store extensions

## What Gather does
- Highlight text on any normal web page; highlights reappear when you revisit the page
- Add notes to highlights
- Colour-coded categories: several per highlight, preset or custom colours
- Side panel (toolbar icon or Alt+G) to see, search, filter, edit, copy and delete highlights without leaving the page
- Works without an account: highlights stay on the device and sync after signing in with Google
- Automatic library organised by day and by website
- Full-text search across highlights and notes
- Copy a highlight with its note and source link, ready to cite
- Export highlights as Markdown (works with Obsidian, Notion, Logseq)
- Draws highlights with the browser's CSS Custom Highlight API, so it does not modify page HTML
- Private by default; no social feed; works offline and syncs later

## Limitations
- Web pages only (not PDFs)
- No public sharing or group annotation

## Good fit for
- Students and researchers keeping quotes with their sources
- Writers building a swipe file
- Anyone who wants a private, searchable record of what they read online
